name: Pankaj Chauhan
title: Tech Lead Engineer
quote: Be the change that you want to see in the world.
tagline: Agentic AI, document AI and LLM pipelines — engineered to stay precise at million-record scale and cheap enough to run every single day.
summary: Engineer with 5+ years in Python and agentic AI, building — and leading teams that build — LLM, RAG and OCR pipelines that deliver 97%+ accuracy across millions of records while cutting operational and LLM costs.
about: I came to this work through a very unglamorous door: a pile of documents nobody could read. Scanned, skewed, stamped, handwritten — pages that held real answers about real people, locked in a format machines were never built for. Turning that mess into something a system can trust still gives me the same quiet thrill it did the first time one of my parsers got a table exactly right.

What keeps me here is who sits at the other end. A loan officer deciding whether a family gets credit. An analyst screening a company before money moves. A compliance team that cannot afford a single wrong name. Every percent of precision I fight for is someone downstream not making a mistake — or not being wrongly flagged for one. That is why I care more about the error I prevent than the model I use.

So I build cheap-first and honest: rules where rules are enough, LLMs where they earn their keep, two independent readers when a mistake would hurt, and a clean “I don't know” over a confident guess. I lead the same way — understand the problem before the code, protect the team's focus, and celebrate the boring, reliable release.

Away from the keyboard you'll usually find me somewhere above the treeline. The mountains taught me most of what I believe about engineering: pack light, respect the conditions, turn back when something is wrong — and keep walking when it's only hard.

roles.title: Tech Lead Engineer
highlights: **Leading a team** delivering AI-driven data intelligence products — owning **feasibility studies**, **cost analysis** and **pipeline design**, while sustaining **95%+ team utilization** and resolving **critical security vulnerabilities** across services.

**Architected a Business Classification Engine** profiling Indian companies from their web footprint, unlocking **lead generation**, **peer comparison** and **AML/KYC due diligence** for KScan, with identity-verified website discovery at **99.4% precision**.

Developed an **LLM-driven taxonomy engine** on **self-hosted Qwen** mapping business activities from company websites to NIC-2008 codes — **98%+ accuracy** at **zero API cost** and **97x faster** candidate retrieval via **embedding caching**.

**Engineered a DGFT Trade-Risk pipeline** monitoring export entities through daily court-judgment analysis, combining multi-stage OCR with **prompt engineering** to classify complex legal risk and extract high-precision compliance parameters.

roles.title: Senior Member of Technical Staff
highlights: **Architected a Corporate Risk platform** monitoring Indian entities and management for adverse-media and governance risk — a 10K/day pipeline with **custom ML noise-filters** and a scalable API layer; **advanced prompt engineering** cut LLM costs by **85%** while classifying fraud, litigation and misconduct.

**Engineered a PEP screening pipeline** extracting PAN from election affidavits in **all Indian languages**, robust to handwritten, rotated and degraded stamp-paper scans; dual-reader **OCR + LLM** consensus delivered **97% precision** at **44% lower cost**.
**Built ocr_kit**, a unified multi-engine OCR framework (Google Vision, Tesseract, Azure) adopted across teams — smart page batching delivered **3.3x faster** processing and **34% lower memory**.

**Built an FIR intelligence pipeline** turning FIR PDFs from **all Indian states and languages** into structured data at million-record scale; custom **table reconstruction** and page-stitched OCR achieved **97.5% accuracy** at **85% lower OCR cost**.
Led **table extraction** research for PDFs and images, delivering a versatile solution that scaled to **10M+ records**.

roles.title: Software Engineer II
highlights: Developed an industry-first **PDF Tampering Detection** solution for banking fraud — analysed 1.5M+ documents and built an automated scoring mechanism that slashed false positives.

**Built Parser Utility**, a **lightning-fast** document-extraction framework unifying PDFs, images and **multi-engine OCR** under one API; declarative **data mappers** and **complex table extraction** turn new formats into configuration, while **character-similarity OCR error correction**, fuzzy search and **smart ROI cropping** cut development time by **80–85%** at **98.6% accuracy**.

roles.title: Software Engineer

Raised **extraction accuracy** by auto-correcting **OCR errors** and handling **skewed or rotated** PDFs and images.
Replaced paid **Adobe APIs** with **in-house parsers** for complex tables, **significantly cutting processing costs**.
Led **RCA** on production API discrepancies and migrated services to **Python 3.11**, improving stability.
